title: Apothem Advisory Auditor Findings
description: Output contract for the advisory-mode conformance / security auditor and the advisory-mode reporting surface. Findings are ADVISORY by default: their presence reports issues but does not block, abort, or force failure on the end user unless the auditor runs with strict = true. Every finding carries a definitive next_step — the determinant advisory move the operator can take. An internal auditor error is itself reported as a finding (category = error), never swallowed.

findings.description: Every finding the auditor produced, in deterministic order.

strict.description: When false (the default), the auditor is advisory: it exits zero even with findings present. When true, findings-present forces a non-zero exit. Strict mode is opt-in, never the shipped default.

finding.description: A single advisory finding. Always carries a definitive next_step.

id.description: Stable finding identifier (e.g., the matcher or check name).

category.description: config-scan: configuration-file scan finding. secret: secret-pattern detection (closed catalog). conformance: rule-based conformance finding. error: an internal auditor failure reported as a finding rather than a silent swallow or crash.

severity.description: Severity triage; advisory regardless of level.

next_step.description: The determinant advisory move — the definitive next action the operator can take to resolve the finding. Always present and non-empty.

path.description: Path to the artifact the finding concerns.

line.description: 1-based line number, when the finding is line-scoped.

column.description: 1-based column number, when the finding is column-scoped.

summary.description: Aggregate finding counts for the run.
